{{Quote|&laquo;''The Loyalist Committee has arrived, Your Honor.''&raquo;<br />"''Good.''"<br />[Dar Wac continues to speak in an alien language]<br />"''Send them in.''|Dar Wac announces the arrival of Supi and the committee to Palpatine|quotestart=0|italics=0|audio=DarWac-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Supi''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. The woman worked as an [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] to [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Supi served alongside the fellow Twi'lek assistant [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], and together they were paraded around by the senator.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she joined Taa at a meeting of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The group was allowed into [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|suite]], where the meeting was held, after he was notified by his assistant [[Dar Wac/Legends|Dar Wac]] of their presence.

==Biography==
Supi was an [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="DB" /> of her [[Species/Legends|species]]' homeworld, the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="DB" /> She served as an [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] to<ref name="DB" /> the Twi'lek male<ref name="DBTaa" /> [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented Ryloth in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DBTaa" /> Supi worked alongside fellow Twi'lek woman [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]],<ref name="DBPampy">{{DB|character|pampy|Pampy}}</ref> and together they were paraded around as badges of prestige by the senator.<ref name="DBTaa" /> The two partners worked together through the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="DBPampy" /> that started in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Separatist Crisis">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the [[Raxus Address/Legends|Raxus Address]], which started the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], to [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref> 

[[File:Supi-LoyalistCommittee-AOTC.png|thumb|right|350px|Supi (center) at Palpatine's suite]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Supi and Pampy accompanied Taa to a meeting of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], a group whose members included Taa and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had recently been the target of a failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination]]. The meeting was held in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] suite in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]], located on<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Upon arrival, the group was let in by<ref name="AOTC" /> the Chancellor's assistant [[Dar Wac/Legends|Dar Wac]],<ref name="Wac">{{DB|character|onacondafarr|Farr, Onaconda}}</ref> just after Palpatine had concluded another meeting with members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="AOTC" />

As the committee entered the suite, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Amidala discussed the recent attempt on the senator's life, before Palpatine interjected with a suggestion to place the Amidala under Jedi protection. After Jedi agreed to the idea, Supi and the Loyalist Committee walked closer to Palpatine as the Jedi left.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Supi, who was considered beautiful, had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DB" /> Orn Free Taa paraded her and Pampy around as badges of prestige.<ref name="DBTaa">{{DB|character|ornfreetaa|Taa, Orn Free}}</ref> Supi's name was similar to "Supisy," a name of Twi'lek origin that translated to "mysterious female."<ref name="Campaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Supi and Pampy were capable, though only one of them&mdash;or a [[Administrative droid/Legends|clerical droid]]&mdash;would suffice for the work they did in the [[Time/Legends|times]] they lived in.<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
The Twi'lek aide often wore an airy [[Sybarion gown]] while she did her duties.<ref name="DB" /> While visiting Palpatine's suite, she wore the marroon [[Clothing/Legends|gown]] with a gray and maroon robe over it and a gray metal headpiece.<ref name="aotcvis" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SupiPampy-ImageAttack.png|thumb|right|250px|The extras who portrayed Supi and Pampy wore mitts.]]
Supi made her first appearance in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="AOTC" /> During filming, the extra who portrayed Supi wore mitts between scenes in order to avoid spreading the character's makeup around.<ref name="Snapshot">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/01/imageattack20030123.html|series=Image Attack|text=Colorful Assistants}}</ref> 

Supi was first pictured in the image archive [[Episode II Select]] on [[StarWars.com]], which showcased images from the production of the then upcoming film. The image showcasing the character was published on [[January 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="EpIISelect">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/select|text=Episode II Select Archive}}</ref> Supi's name was first mentioned, but not linked to the character's image, in the StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Orn Free Taa,<ref name="DBTaa" /> posted on [[August 22]], 2001.<ref name="InsideSenate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2001/08/news20010822.html|text=Inside the Galactic Senate}}</ref> The name was then connected with the character through the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref>
